audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Akali wins Levels 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items, while the prose on the same page (mid, late, whys[2], whys[3], whys[5]) says all four of those stages are Urgot's. The chart also gives Level 6 to Urgot while spikes[1], mid and whys[4] all call Level 6 her window.
audit.why: 54.48% over 1584 games is a clearly favoured lane for Urgot, and the packet chart reads Urgot on every row but one. The only stage every text source agrees is Akali's is Level 6, when Perfect Execution comes online.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Urgot / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot / Akali / Urgot / Urgot. Proposed as one atomic group with the matching win[N] rows and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; Level 6 phase text talks about Urgot's execute on the row that is actually Akali's spike.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1, Twilight Shroud 20s, Shuriken Flip 16s, and Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1. Those numbers are what make 'wait it out' concrete.
audit.corrected: R 120s, W 20s, E 16s and the 110-energy Q cost written into spikes and the cooldowns breakdown; Level 6 phase rewritten as her spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] says 'E her into the shrapnel' (Corrosive Charge is an explosive charge, no shrapnel) and blames her 'passive energy pool' — her passive is Assassin's Mark, an auto reset, not an energy mechanic. spikes[3] claims 'her Q healing scales'; Five Point Strike does damage and a slow, no heal. The Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell is missing entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on all three. The auto reset is the real burst tell: her combo opens with the empowered attack, so the wind-up, not an ability cast, is the cue to step out.
audit.corrected: Q described as the explosive charge plus slow, the energy claim replaced with Five Point Strike's 110 rank-1 cost, the fabricated Q heal removed, and the Assassin's Mark reset tell written into spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] tells you to 'bait the W shroud then E her out of it', but Riot's Twilight Shroud text says she cannot be selected by enemy spells and attacks while inside.
audit.why: Whether Disdain's directional charge still catches an unselectable champion is a collision question Riot's text does not answer, so I did not assert either way.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Akali is simply dead. Trade her to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Perfect Execution gives her two dashes and an execute on a 120s rank-1 cooldown. Hold Disdain for her re-cast, not for the smoke.

edits.before: Through 4-5 her lack of mobility lets you keep shredding her.
edits.after: Through 4-5 her 16s Shuriken Flip is her only out — shred her.

edits.before: Pre-6 Akali has no escape, so bully her: land Q on her landing spot, E her into the shrapnel, and W-shred her down every time she walks up for a Q or last-hit since her passive energy pool caps her trading.
edits.after: Pre-6 Akali has no escape: land Corrosive Charge where she must stand, Disdain her out of range, then W-shred her every time she steps up — Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1, which caps how often she can trade.

edits.before: This is her window; her R Perfect Execution gives two dashes plus a gap-close execute, and her W shroud makes her untargetable, so respect the level-6 all-in and don't blow E into the smoke.
edits.after: This is her window; Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1, two dashes plus an execute, and Twilight Shroud carries a 20s cooldown she can hide the whole trade inside — hold Disdain for her re-cast dash.

edits.before: Once you have tank/HP and Akali has her first item she can burst-and-vanish, but if you bait her shroud early you can E her out of it and Q-shred her before she recovers energy.
edits.after: Once she has her first item Akali can burst-and-vanish, and her combo opens with an Assassin's Mark auto reset — step out on that wind-up, not the ability cast, then punish her while her energy is empty.

edits.before: Late you tank her combo far better than she deletes you; her Q healing scales but Corrosive Charge shred plus your R execute turn her all-in into a suicide if she mistimes the shroud.
edits.after: Late you tank her combo far better than she deletes you; her burst scales but Corrosive Charge's slow plus your R execute turn her all-in into a suicide if she mistimes the shroud or lands Q short.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay yours because she has no mobility yet and your Q-into-E out-trades her burst, but at 6 her R gives her the double-dash execute and shroud escape, so that single level tips to her.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay yours because Shuriken Flip on 16s is her only dash and your Q-into-Disdain out-trades her burst, but at 6 Perfect Execution's double dash and execute tip that one level to her.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside it. Shred when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1 and she is unselectable inside it. Wait it out, then shred.

notes: The chart on disk disagreed with its own prose in five of seven rows. I rebuilt it from the prose plus the 54.48% win rate: Level 6 is the only Akali row. Note the packet levelChart disagrees on exactly two rows (it has Level 6 as Urgot and First item as Akali) — I went with the three prose sources that all name Level 6 as her spike. Not edited: wants.you[1] tells you to Disdain her out of Twilight Shroud, but Riot's text says she is unselectable inside it and does not say whether a directional charge still catches her. Left alone deliberately.
